title: 翻卡与计分练习
prompt: “帮我记西班牙语单词，可翻卡、随机抽题和计分。”
program:
root = Col([title, intro, trainer, sampleNote])

$mode = "study"
$quizDeck = []
$quizIndex = 0
$sel = ""
$answered = false
$score = 0

title = Title("西班牙语单词卡", "xl")
intro = Text("先翻卡熟悉单词，再进入随机测验：每轮从示例词表中抽题，答对计分。示例词表可自行替换。", "md", "muted")
modeControl = SegmentedControl($mode, [{value: "study", label: "翻卡学习"}, {value: "quiz", label: "随机测验"}], true)
studyView = Col([Caption("点击卡片翻面 · 左右滑动切换"), Carousel(@Each(cards, "c", Flashcard(c.front, c.back, c.hint)), 250, 3)], 3)
quizStart = Col([Text("从 " + @Count(cards) + " 张示例词卡中随机抽题，答对得 1 分。", "sm"), Button("开始随机测验", Action([@Set($quizDeck, @Shuffle(cards)), @Set($quizIndex, 0), @Set($score, 0), @Set($sel, ""), @Set($answered, false)]), "solid", null, "lg", "shuffle")], 3, "center")
current = @Find($quizDeck, "n", $quizIndex + 1)
quizQuestion = Col([Row([Caption("第 " + ($quizIndex + 1) + " / " + @Count($quizDeck) + " 题"), Spacer(), Caption("得分 " + $score)], 2), Title(current.prompt, "md"), Text("选择正确的中文释义", "xs", "muted"), Col(@Each(current.options, "opt", Pressable([Row([Icon($sel == opt ? "check-circle" : "circle", "sm"), Text(opt, "sm")], 2)], @Set($sel, $answered ? $sel : opt), $sel == opt, 3, $sel == opt ? "info" : "surface", "md")), 2), $answered ? Col([Text($sel == current.answer ? "✅ 正确，+1 分" : "❌ 正确答案：" + current.answer, "sm", $sel == current.answer ? "success" : "danger", "medium"), Row([Button($quizIndex + 1 >= @Count($quizDeck) ? "看成绩" : "下一题", Action([@Set($quizIndex, $quizIndex + 1), @Set($sel, ""), @Set($answered, false)]), "solid", null, null, "arrow-right")], 2, null, "end")], 3) : Button("检查答案", Action([@Set($answered, true), @Set($score, $score + ($sel == current.answer ? 1 : 0))]), "solid", null, "lg", "check", $sel == "")], 3)
quizResult = Col([Title("本轮完成 🎉", "md"), Text("共 " + @Count($quizDeck) + " 题，答对 " + $score + " 题。", "md"), Text(@Round(@Percent($score, @Count($quizDeck))) + "% 正确率", "sm", "muted"), Row([Button("再测一轮", Action([@Set($quizDeck, @Shuffle(cards)), @Set($quizIndex, 0), @Set($score, 0), @Set($sel, ""), @Set($answered, false)]), "solid", null, null, "rotate-cw"), Button("回到学习", @Set($mode, "study"), "outline")], 2, null, "center")], 4, "center")
quizEntry = @Count($quizDeck) == 0 ? quizStart : ($quizIndex < @Count($quizDeck) ? quizQuestion : quizResult)
modeContent = $mode == "study" ? studyView : quizEntry
trainer = Card([modeControl, modeContent], "soft", 4, 3)
sampleNote = Text("示例词表 · 共 " + @Count(cards) + " 张，可直接替换为你的生词本。", "xs", "muted")

cards = [
  {n: 1, front: "la manzana", back: "苹果", answer: "苹果", hint: "水果", options: ["苹果", "房子", "书", "狗"]},
  {n: 2, front: "el perro", back: "狗", answer: "狗", hint: "动物", options: ["猫", "狗", "鸟", "鱼"]},
  {n: 3, front: "la casa", back: "房子", answer: "房子", hint: "居住", options: ["房子", "汽车", "学校", "公园"]},
  {n: 4, front: "el libro", back: "书", answer: "书", hint: "学习", options: ["书", "桌子", "笔", "门"]},
  {n: 5, front: "comer", back: "吃", answer: "吃", hint: "动词", options: ["喝", "吃", "跑", "睡"]},
  {n: 6, front: "beber", back: "喝", answer: "喝", hint: "动词", options: ["喝", "吃", "看", "说"]},
  {n: 7, front: "el agua", back: "水", answer: "水", hint: "饮品", options: ["水", "牛奶", "咖啡", "果汁"]},
  {n: 8, front: "la escuela", back: "学校", answer: "学校", hint: "场所", options: ["学校", "医院", "银行", "超市"]},
  {n: 9, front: "el coche", back: "汽车", answer: "汽车", hint: "交通", options: ["汽车", "火车", "飞机", "自行车"]},
  {n: 10, front: "rojo", back: "红色的", answer: "红色的", hint: "颜色", options: ["红色的", "蓝色的", "绿色的", "黄色的"]}
]
